verdict.rationale: Autonomous AI decisioning is a fair question for a CDP and engagement platform, but the evidence never shows Segment AI agents choosing message, timing, or channel per customer. The closest items are AI-powered audiences and Engage audience building and activation, which are adjacent features, not autonomous decisioning. Nothing in the pack covers guardrails or measured lift.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI decisioning agents pick messages, timing, and channels per customer autonomously within guardrails I set, with measurable lift
